name: Outlier AI
countries: 60+ countries incl. Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, South Africa, US, UK, most of EU
req: 18+, government ID, PayPal or bank account, laptop/smartphone, fluent English for most projects
steps: Sign up on site > select country > take a general assessment > pass project-specific qualification tests > wait for task assignment
rules: Pay is region-tiered; task availability is inconsistent. Treat as supplemental income.
flags: Never asks for payment to join. If an Outlier page asks for a fee or crypto, it is an impersonator.

name: Mindrift
owner: Toloka AI (absorbed Toloka crowd work in 2026)
countries: Most countries incl. Nigeria and broader Africa (region-tiered pay)
req: 18+, smartphone or laptop, domain expertise for higher-paying boards, Payoneer account
steps: Apply on mindrift.ai > select expertise domain > complete skills assessment > get matched to open projects
rules: Pay is cost-of-living indexed. Specialist boards pay more than general work.
flags: Calculate the real hourly rate before accepting a fixed-price task.

name: DataAnnotation.tech
countries: Primarily US, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand; some African access project-by-project
req: 18+, PayPal account, unpaid entry assessment (1-3 hrs)
steps: Apply on site > complete unpaid qualifying assessment > pass topic-specific tests > accept tasks
rules: Entry assessment is unpaid. Acceptance rate is low.
flags: Verify your country at signup before investing assessment time.

name: Alignerr
countries: Global, including Nigeria and Africa; competitive entry
req: Domain expertise or strong writing/coding skill, ID verification, laptop
steps: Apply at alignerr.com > select expertise area > complete assessment > await project invitation
rules: Best for people with a subject strength (law, coding, medicine, languages).
flags: Legitimate. Backed by Labelbox. No upfront fees.

name: Toloka
owner: Toloka AI BV (crowd work merged into Mindrift, July 2026)
countries: 100+ countries incl. most of Africa
pay: Under $3-20 on the open crowd; invite-only expert track pays more
req: 18+, smartphone sufficient for many tasks, no experience required
steps: Sign up > browse open task pools > complete short tasks
rules: Open crowd pays very little. Use it to build a task history, not as income.
flags: Beginner-friendly and open-access, with the lowest pay on this list. Prefer Mindrift for new work.

name: Prolific
countries: Confirmed: US, UK, most of EU, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, Egypt
req: 18+, accurate demographic profile, PayPal or bank
steps: Register > complete profile screening > browse and accept studies
rules: Pay is shown before you accept. Profile must be accurate or the account can be suspended.
flags: Reputable in academic research circles.

name: Remotasks
countries: Most countries incl. Nigeria, Kenya, Philippines, India
req: 18+, smartphone/laptop, unpaid training modules before paid work
steps: Sign up > complete free training > pass certification quiz > begin paid tasks
rules: Volume dropped after 2025 Scale AI restructuring. Treat as backup.
flags: Legitimate but lower-volume than its 2023-2024 peak.

name: Appen (Appen Connect / CrowdGen)
countries: 170+ countries
req: 18+, government ID, resume/profile with language skills
steps: Register at appen.com > select country and languages > wait for project invitations > pass qualification exam
rules: Work arrives as invitations, not an open task board.
flags: Public company. Never pay to join.

name: Clickworker
countries: 136 countries
req: 18+, PayPal, ID for UHRS access, basic computer skills
steps: Register on Clickworker Workplace > complete profile assessments > unlock task categories
rules: UHRS needs a separate English test. Reliable volume, low per-task pay.
flags: Established. Low pay is the tradeoff, not legitimacy.

name: Surge AI
countries: Selective by project; strong presence for Kenyan/African vetted workers
req: Domain tests, background checks, ongoing performance review
steps: Apply (often via referral) > pass domain tests > background check > quality evaluation
rules: Not an open sign-up. Competitive and quality-gated.
flags: Legitimate and well-funded. Clients include major AI labs.

name: TELUS Digital AI Community
countries: 100+ countries
req: 18+, ID verification, language proficiency, reliable internet
steps: Apply via TELUS Digital AI Community > select a project > pass the exam
rules: Some projects require fixed daily availability windows.
flags: Backed by TELUS. Check hours before applying.

name: OneForma
countries: Global, strongest for bilingual applicants
pay: 14-20 typical, higher for niche language pairs
req: 18+, language proficiency, smartphone for some mobile projects
steps: Register at oneforma.com > build profile > pass project assessment
rules: Your country is shown first; other projects may still be visible.
flags: Legitimate TELUS-family vendor.

name: Mercor
countries: 45+ countries
req: Professional or technical background; 20-min AI video interview
steps: Sign up at work.mercor.com > build profile > complete AI interview > get matched
rules: Interview can be retaken a limited number of times.
flags: Legitimate marketplace, not a microtask board.

name: Micro1
cat: Expert AI training & vetted technical roles
countries: Global, selective via AI interviewer Zara
req: Subject-matter expertise; pass AI interview
steps: Apply on micro1.ai > AI interview > earn Certified badge > matched to projects
rules: Certification is a real gate, not a paywall.
flags: Well-funded and legitimate. Not instant-start.

name: iMerit
countries: Operates in specific regions (India, US, select global)
req: Formal application; often full/part-time rather than gig tasks
steps: Apply through iMerit careers > interview / hiring process
rules: More like a job than a gig platform.
flags: Expect a hiring process, not instant signup.

name: Sama
countries: Primarily East Africa (Kenya, Uganda) and select regions
req: Formal application and interview
steps: Apply through Sama careers for open annotation roles
rules: Impact-sourcing company. Roles are often jobs with benefits.
flags: Legitimate. Not designed for instant flexible signup.

name: Welocalize RaterLabs
countries: English-fluent countries, including parts of Africa
req: 18+, strong English, aptitude test
steps: Apply via RaterLabs postings > qualification exam > assigned project hours
rules: Quality scoring affects continued access.
flags: Long-running search-quality vendor. Legitimate.

name: CrowdGen
countries: 200+ countries
req: 18+, no experience required
steps: Sign up at crowdgen.com > browse open tasks > complete instantly
rules: Rate is shown before you accept each task.
flags: Beginner entry into the Appen ecosystem.

name: UHRS (Microsoft)
countries: Wide, but vendor-gated — not a direct signup
req: English test and vendor qualification (e.g. Clickworker)
steps: Access only through an approved vendor > pass UHRS test > tasks unlock
payMethod: Via the vendor (e.g. PayPal through Clickworker)
rules: You cannot sign up to UHRS directly.
flags: Direct-access UHRS offers outside known vendors are a common scam.

name: Voices.com
countries: Global
req: Recording setup, voice demo reel, account verification
steps: Create a profile > upload demo > audition > accept project rate
rules: Read licensing terms before accepting AI-voice deals.
flags: Legitimate voice marketplace. Needs more setup than microtask sites.
